question: Where is the four-path crossing located within the subtle body?
premises: A four-path crossing arises from the meeting of three, in relation to the holder of power and dissolution.
The teachers consider this crossing to be located right there in dissolution.
In the body it is established as ending at the nose-tip and the palate cavity.
inference: The four-path crossing is mapped internally to the region ending at the nose-tip and the palate cavity, associated with dissolution in the holder of power.
uncertainties: The precise yogic locus of 'nāsānta-tālurandhrānta' (nose-tip to palate cavity) admits multiple interpretations in subtle-body mapping.
plain_english: From the meeting of three comes the four-path crossing; they consider it to arise from dissolution in the holder of power right there. In the body it is established as the region ending at the nose-tip and the palate cavity.
